# AMQP Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the AMQP Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.amqptrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the AMQP Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate AMQP Trigger node into your workflows.

[AMQP](https://www.amqp.org/) is an open standard application layer protocol for message-oriented middleware. The defining features of AMQP are message orientation, queuing, routing, reliability and security. This node supports AMQP 1.0 compatible message brokers.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [AMQP credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/amqp) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}

{% endhint %}
